//: Copy to appsettings.Docker.json and fill in. That file is gitignored and mounted into the container by docker-compose.yml, so no secret is passed on the command line, stored in compose, or baked into the image.

ConnectionStrings.//: Host is the compose service name, not localhost - the API resolves 'db' on the compose network.

Jwt.//: Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48. Must be at least 32 bytes or the API refuses to start.

Smtp.//: Point Host at a mail catcher (e.g. the mailpit service) to read reset codes. Delivery is queued off the request path, so an unreachable server only logs a warning.
